talas.t: Still up? Night shift at the booth ends 2am, my feet are dead
Go to sleep Begaiym. The Talasbank queue will be there tomorrow
Kayırluu tañ. -4 in the low fields this morning, frost on everything
Kayırluu tañ. Horses are fine, they have the blankets on. Hay is in the barn
Kayırluu tañ! Bars did not want to leave the bed. Sorry Aizada, I will not make the Saturday walk if it is -4 🥶
Kayırluu tañ Gulzada 🧣 Saturday is still on, we go at 11 when it warms up
14 bus is on time this morning, I checked. Trans-Talas lane is open again 🙌
Rahmat Elnur. Anyone know a good shop for a phone screen? Mine cracked on the bus, ironic for a repairer 😅
Ha. Shoemaker's kid has no shoes. Try Oyrot on Kurmanjan street, they are fair
Oyrot is a competitor, I am not going to them lol. Jakshı, rahmat
Rustam don't be proud, bring it to me on lunch. Booth is 2 min from the bazar 😂
Talas 2.1 in the air app? Nurzhan is 164 today, the Iyık Janyl one is worse. Windows shut again
Talas 150 this morning, unhealthy for sensitive groups. Don't go running Gulzada
Running? I can barely climb the kindergarten stairs in this 😂
Heating is on everywhere now. My coal bill for the cellar is 4 sacks more than last year. Not happy
Wood is cheaper than coal at the Hippodrome yard if you buy by the cart. Ask Akmat there
Rahmat Marat, I will ask. I cannot pay for another cart this month though
Tulpar Talas season tickets for the play-offs are on sale at the stadium box office. Hippodrome 12 Dec is the Talas semi, 21:00. Book early
Talas v Highland winner on 19 Dec final? Is that the one at the Hippodrome too?
19 Dec final is at the State Hippodrome, 19:00. Semi 1 is Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00 on the 12th
Chu v Highland. I thought Chu was just ulak, not football lol
Ulak is the ISEZ and Highland teams. Chu team in the football play-offs is a different thing, Elnur. Read the table 😂
I am reading the ulak table, the Chu one has 26 points, 10 games. Talas is 25 for us 🐎
Talas 25 in ISEZ, that is the Talas ulak side. Good, we are second. Chu first, Lower Naryn sixth. Wait for Saturday
Taxi from Talas to Iyık Janyl this morning? Bus is 45 som, marshrutka is cheaper I think
Bus Talas-Iyık Janyl is 45. Taxi is more. Don't do taxi unless you have 3 people
Ok bus it is. Thursday teahouse, anyone bringing boorsok again?
Only if somebody brings the tea, last time we had 6 people and one teapot 😅
[sticker: chai]
Lunch rate check: USD 11.50 buy, 12.00 sell at Bazar-i Kalan this morning. Euro 12.50/13.10. Official is 8.40 so the gap is big
Official rate is 8.40 since 2008 and the bazar is 12. Who is the stranger that changes at 12?
Not a stranger, Bakyt. It is me on the booth at 12 😂 Official rate is official, we just do the cash
My cousin in Nurzhan is sending money for the flat deposit. The changer quoted him different, why?
Ask for the 100 RUB rate too, that is 13.25 buy 14.45 sell this morning. Compare before you walk in
Bank counter says the same thing: official for the paper, bazar for the cash. Nobody wins except the queue
Lunch. Tyres are quiet today, three cars and one truck. Cold weather brings the winter tyre people
Winter tyres are needed on the Fergana Gateway now. Ala-Bel chains or winter tyres, the sign says so
Yes Elnur. And the Otmek pass is closed, so nobody is going to Chatkal by car anyway
Kindergarten kids are making paper snowflakes. Three of them asked if the horses in Talas are cold. I said yes, get a blanket 🐴
Tell them the horses are wearing coats and eating hay. Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale, so they are well fed 😄
26 a bale this year. Last year it was 19. Dry summer. Ok, the potatoes are 2.10 a kilo here if anyone wants
Bakyt you are always selling 😂
Still no word on the Jibek Jolu fire report. Aunt says the case is still just a folder in the court
Sorry Nurbek. Herald said adjourned, that's all we know
Walnuts are 22 a kilo in Toktogul bazar, my mother says, she wants me to buy a bag for the flat
Ask Rustam if the walnuts come with a phone repair 😂
Only for teachers 🙂
The sort of quiet afternoon at the Talasbank branch. Two people in the queue, both asking for the same coin info 🙄
Coin info is my afternoon too. Tulparcoin is 3.45 cents offshore at noon, down 2.2% today. Still not legal tender btw
Not legal tender. Not a bank product. Tulpar tickets are in som, Begaiym
I know Timur 😂 I'm just saying the number. Going back to my booth
Dark already at 16:40. Heating in the bus is off again, sitting in my coat
Shift ends at 18. Then teahouse for the language exchange? Will try not to speak Russian every sentence
Ooba! Come, 18:30. Bring someone who speaks Iradi so you have a partner 🙂
Talas 150 at 17:00. The inversion is sitting on the city, Iyık Janyl says the same. Gas heaters make it worse
Inversion always. Walk the cold air, the smoke stays down in the valley. Good night to close windows
[sticker: haha]
Diesel 6.10 at my pump on Trans-Talas. Don't ask me to be happy about it
Petrol 95 is 5.85 at the Talas stations. 92 is 5.40. Tank is full, I drive the 14 bus, not my car, so I don't care lol
You drive the bus Elnur, the company pays. Ha
Off to the Tündük, see you all there 🧣
Here. Two students and a boorsok 🙌
I am coming late, bus is slow in the cold. Save me a seat by the stove
Begaiym, the stove is taken by a boy doing a Spanish test 😂
Tulpar Talas is 2 pts ahead of nobody, we are 62, Neftchi 63. One point gap at the top now that the league is over, sorry for the repeat 😂
You said it again Timur. The league is over. We know. Neftchi champs
Champs at 63, we are second with 62. The Irad Cup final is 7 Nov, they beat Attelkom 2-0 already, so lol
Shh, let me read. Bars has a new blanket, the one with the green stripes, he sleeps on it now 🐶
Two steps forward, one back. Kayırluu kech. The Old City road is ice again at 19:00
Kech jakshı. Thanks Nurbek. Chains on, I walk to the stop
Night is coming, the horses are in, hay is in. Two horses and a tyre shop, that is my whole life
Marat you need a hobby 😂
I have a hobby, Aizada. It is the horses 🐎
Got home by the 32 bus. Board at the terminal said the next one is 20 min. Waited in the cold 🥶
Night shift for me tomorrow, the 14 is at 6:10. Please don't be late Timur
I am never late, Elnur. Only the bus is late
Bars says goodnight, he is on the radiator again. I give up 🐶
Did anyone read the Herald about the Toktogul official? Herding family from Ozgörüsh reported him. Brave people
Yes I read. Bribe. Toktogul is far, nothing changes for us in Talas. But good for them
Herding family reporting a bribe, that's a story. My cousin's cousin is in Toktogul, she said they all talk about it
Careful what you repeat, Begaiym 🙂
I only say what the Herald says Rustam 😂
Talasbank says the 2027 budget draft is near. NurGaz paid 10.9bn som, a third of their 2026 revenue. Big company
Big company, big tax. Fuel tax up 9% to 468m som Jan-Oct, pump prices unchanged. So they pay it, we pay at the pump, fine
Pump prices are the same as last month for me. Petrol 92 5.40. Nothing changed for the bus
Diesel in the Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75 per my cousin. Way more than here. No one counts it there
Chatkal diesel unrecorded, the Herald wrote. Our diesel is on the books, their diesel is not
Sorry, the Chatkal survey adit is at 800 of 1,500 metres. No contract, no cost, no financing yet. Just a hole in the mountain
A hole with a number. Nice 😂
Tonight the Tündük had 14 people. Thursday is growing. Rahmat all who came 🙏
Rahmat Aizada. My Iradi is still chala but I asked for boorsok in Iradi and the boy laughed 😂
That is how you learn 🧣
[sticker: jailoo]
Jailoo in the summer, Gulzada. Now it is the stable and the hay, but I like the picture
Who is going to the Hippodrome on 12 Dec? I want to see the Talas semi before I die 😂
Season ticket holders get the seats by the stands. Bakyt, buy the match ticket, not the potatoes
Potatoes pay for the ticket Timur. Rahmat
Talas and Nurzhan both 150 and 164 tonight. Air is bad. Night all, windows shut
Night Nurbek. Don't open the window for the smell of coal 🧣
Night everyone. Tomorrow is Friday, booth opens at 9. Changers rate tomorrow, don't ask me first
Night. Friday queue at the bank, I'll be there
Night. Shift at 8, the first phone of the day is always the same, a cracked screen 😅
Night all. Bars says night too 🐶
Night. Tyres on the rack, horses in, hay in. Good night Talas
Night. 6:10 bus, I'm going to bed like a horse
Night everyone. Saturday walk to the Old City at 11, bring the warm hats 🧣❄️
Night. Potatoes 2.10 tomorrow, rahmat all
Still up. Air monitor says Talas 157 now. Unhealthy. Kids asleep, windows shut
Kayırluu tañ. Minus 7 at the stop, the bus is late again 🥶
Kayırluu tañ! Clear sky over the Old City, frost on every car. Warm hats today 🧣
Frost on the tyres rack too. Morning horse check done, all three fine. Jakshı
Minus 7 in town, minus 6 at Kyzyl-Adyr they say. Potatoes in the cellar are fine, the cold is good for them
Bars did not want to go out, cold paws 😂 Kids in two layers each
Friday queue at the Talasbank branch already at 7:30. Pension day plus everyone changing dollars before the weekend
Booth opens at 9 today. Changers in the bazar are 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell for USD this morning. EUR 12.50/13.10
11.95 sell for dollars and the bank gives 8.40. Who decided that gap 😂
Not me, I just count it 😅
Shift at 8. Already got a cracked screen and a phone with no sound. Friday is the same as Monday here
Rustam your Iradi is getting better, 'Kayırluu tañ' with the right ending 🙂
Rahmat! Taught by the best 🙏
Trans-Talas near the North Terminal is still one lane. The 14 is 10 min late again
Heating is on in my building but the radiators are only warm at the bottom. Anyone else?
Ours too. The district heating is on, but it takes days to get up to the top floor
So we wait till Sunday to be warm. Lovely 😅
Thursday exchange at the Tündük: 14 people last time, can we get 20 next week? Bring someone who has never come 🙏
I'll bring my cousin, he speaks better Iradi than me. Shame for him 😂
Tulpar Talas and Neftchi finished level on points after last round? No. Neftchi are champions already, we are 2nd on 62, one point less than the title. Season ticket still for us 🔵⚪
Neftchi champions already, that's the sad part. Irad Cup final was 2-0 to them on the 7th
Yes. Attelkom 2nd in the cup, still a good season for them
Reminder: Liberty Boulevard is open again, the Swiss parade was in October, no more closures. Taxis calm down 😂
Still remember the Swiss band, the drums in the street were loud 😄
Tyre shop: winter tyres sold out on the Trans-Talas. People are coming with snow in their boots
The Fergana Gateway needs chains or winter tyres now. Saw two trucks with chains going to Ala-Bel
Hay for the horses went up again? My husband's cousin in the valleys says a bale is 26 som now
26 yes, and I bought at 24 in the summer. Winter is always expensive, Gulzada 🐎
Potatoes 2.10 a kilo at the bazar now. Still cheaper than the Kazakh ones in February 😂
Lol Bakyt you said that already
Any news on the Jibek Jolu fire report? My aunt still selling from home
Nothing new since the adjournment. Herald says the fire service has not sent it yet
Rahmat. Nothing moves in this city except the air
Who is going to the Hippodrome on 12 Dec? Talas v Chu semi is at 19:00 and Talas plays the Highland winners at 21:00 🐎
Me. 19:00 is the Chu game, 21:00 is us, so I stay for both. Timur gets me the seat
Season ticket seats are by the stands. Match ticket for you, Bakyt. Potatoes can wait
Hippodrome stables are busy this week, the grooms want the hay in before the snow gets heavy
Lunch. Plov at the Tündük is 28 som a plate today, it's the only thing I eat until 6 😂
Plov 28 again? Last week it was 26 at the corner shop. Winter prices 😅
Corner shop is cheaper but the rice is not the same, Rustam
Talas air is bad again. 157 on the monitor. Who has a mask? My son's school asked us
Coal smoke sits on the city in the inversion. Keep the kids indoors at recess if you can
Lower Naryn had 71 new firms in nine months, 31 in Bazar-Korgon. Herald says about 520 jobs. Not bad for a valley
520 jobs, how many of them are in the bazar? Ask me, I'll tell you 😂
Ask the Herald, they have the table
Anyone know if the air terminal has more flights for summer? My brother wants to fly to Nurzhan in June
Talas air terminal has room for more flights. Summer 2027 routes still open, the Herald said
Good, then the bus ticket is safe for another year 😄
Jailoo in winter again 😭 Show me the spring, Marat
Spring is in the calendar, Gulzada. Hay is in the stable
Walnuts in Toktogul bazar 22 som a kilo for my niece's order. Not for me, I eat potatoes 😂
Walnut cake for the Thursday exchange? Someone should bring one 🥮
Kids made paper snowflakes in class today. Half the room is wet now 😅
Toktogul reservoir 80.6% full and dropping. Power is normal in Talas, no cuts planned. Good for the winter
Power is on, heating is on, air is not. Talas is 157, Nurzhan is 212. Nurzhan is worse. Don't go out without a mask
Nurzhan 212 is really bad. My old flat was on the hill, every morning I could smell the refinery
Kosh means move the car, Begaiym? 😂
Kosh means the bazar is closing, go home 😂
Thursday exchange next week: free boorsok for first timers. Rustam, bring the cousin 🙂
Deal. He says he will only speak Iradi, I say English 😂
Attelkom Talas v Kara-Buura was 2-0 to Attelkom, the last round. Kara-Buura at the bottom half now, sad
Kara-Buura 9th on 25 pts. At least not the bottom. Naryn Tash-Kömür are last on 8, that's a real problem
Walking to the Tündük for coffee, anyone going? Air is bad but the tea is hot
Too cold for me tonight. Bars is at home, rahmat 🐶
Rahmat for the update Timur. Chatkal diesel is unrecorded still, Herald wrote that again
Chatkal diesel 8.55 to 9.75 at the villages, my cousin says. Ours at the pump is 6.10 diesel, 5.40 petrol 92. Nobody checks the Chatkal pump
Nobody checks anything in the Chatkal. Like the survey adit, a hole and no number
800 of 1,500 metres. Still no contract. I told you 😂
Taxi from the Tündük to the centre is 15 som from now, the driver said. Walking is also fine tonight, minus 7
Marshrutka Talas to Kyzyl-Adyr is 30 som. Going there on the weekend for the hot springs? 🧣
Bus Talas to Nurzhan is 32, marshrutka 38. The marshrutka is faster and smells of tobacco 😂
Repair counter closes at 6 on Friday. Some nights I work on the phones at home. Winter is hard on screens
Tulparcoin is down 3.7% today, 3.32 US cents. Not legal tender, don't bother 😂
Tulparcoin is not money, Timur. I can't change it, nobody can
Dastgoh Nurzhan beat Surma Chatkal 2-1, last round. Dastgoh 3rd on 42 points
Dastgoh got 3rd by beating Surma, and Surma is 6th on 36. Next season we will see
Ulak in the Chu game next week? Kara-Bulak are in the table on 12 pts, Sary-Bulak on 10. Not many of us watch
Ulak is on Jarysh, not here. Kara-Bulak with 12 points, rahmat for the numbers Marat 🐎
Talas is 157 still and Nurzhan 212. Windows shut again tonight, Aizada
Don't open them. Rahmat for the warning Nurbek. Stay warm all
Tomorrow I'm not going to the bazar, it's minus 7 and I'm a bus man. 6:10 bus back to the depot
Potatoes 2.10 still. Sell me your bus ride for two sacks, Elnur
Bakyt you can't pay in potatoes 😂
Snow is coming to the Old City tonight they say. Good for the kids to see it
Kara-Buura plays their next match Saturday on the football side, the table will move. Who is in?
Night all. Horses fed, tyres covered. Hay for the week, 26 som a bale, Gulzada, I checked
Night. Mask on the hook for tomorrow
Night. Tomorrow is Saturday, the booth is closed. Don't ask me about the rate on Sunday
Night everyone. Saturday walk to the Old City at 11 still on, bring the warm hats 🧣❄️
Night. Phone repair counter opens 9 Saturday, Bars wants a new collar 😂
Night. Friday queue done. Talasbank says the dollar window is quiet, rates unchanged
Night all 🐶
Night. Potatoes 2.10 tomorrow, rahmat all
Can't sleep, the radiator is knocking again. Anyone else?
Night shift for the buses. Go to bed Nurbek 😂
Kayırluu tañ! Mountains white again, and the Old City walk is on at 11 if it doesn't snow too hard
Kayırluu tañ! Kids want to see snow, I said we go after nap
Frost on the potato field this morning. -9 in town they say. Hope the cellar is dry
Salam. Wind on the Trans-Talas is brutal, my hands are dead already 🥶
Horses fine. Tyres on the shop floor, I'm not going out before 9
Booth closed today, rate board says whatever it says Monday 😂
Working Monday. Talasbank queue at 8 was already long. Pensioners with coal money
Coal is 3 times what it was last year my neighbour says. Ugh
Wood is the same as last year here. Pay the bus, buy the wood, eat potatoes 😂
Air in Nurzhan again, Nurbek sent me the number. Talas is 155, unhealthy. Don't run outside Aizada
I'm walking with the kids in the park, not running. Rahmat for the warning Elnur
Anyone going to Nurzhan this weekend? Need a tyre chain for the car, the Ala-Bel roads look bad
Fergana Gateway open with chains. Winter tyres required, they checked at the Ala-Bel post last week
Jakshı, rahmat. Bus is 32 then. Chains I'll buy at the bazar
Anyone buy walnuts? Aunt says 22 som a kilo at Toktogul bazar, she's sending some to Talas, kids love them
22 is good for walnuts 🥜 Send me a kilo, I'll pay on Monday
Deal. Rahmat
Hay in the valleys still 26 a bale. Heard the Chu side is dearer. Bought my week already
Chu apples at 3.45 a kilo, that's a lot for apples. Mine are still in the store, jakshı
Thursday exchange is on as usual, 18:30 at Tündük. Bring new people! Rustam, you're coming?
Yes, I'll bring my bad Iradi. Someone teach me kayırluu tañ properly 😅
Tulpar Talas got 2-2 with Akademiya in the women's league. Not bad for them. Season over for us anyway
Our women's team is top of the women's table with Universitet 2 behind, can't believe it 🙌
Only 1 point ahead of Universitet at the end. Tough to say they're champions yet 😂
Ok the women's league is over, Tulpar 23, Universitet 22. Stop arguing Timur
I'm not arguing 😤 Congrats to the girls anyway
Lunch. Plov at the stand by the tyre shop, 28 a plate, still the best in Talas
28 is fine for plov. Potatoes 2.10 still, I'm not selling mine cheap
Bakyt you're the only one who talks about potatoes on a Saturday 😂
Asked the exchange booth about the dollar. 8.40 official but nobody gives it. Begaiym?
Rustam, the official rate is 8.40 and it hasn't moved since 2008. Street changers this morning were 11.45 buy and 12 sell. Don't tell my boss I said it 😂
Talasbank says the same thing. Nobody uses the official one except the ministry 😂
Taking the bus Talas-Nurzhan tomorrow for my aunt's dishes 32 som. Anyone else doing that?
Bus is calm on Sundays. Bring a thermos Nurbek
Heard the Iradiya E190 got a lie-flat seat, business class. Who flies that route? I'd take it 😄
Only if the bus is cancelled. 4 hours in a seat that folds down, sure
Iradiya added one E190 as cover for two rotations, winter timetable unchanged. So nothing changes for us this winter
Talas air terminal has room for more flights, summer 2027 routes still open. The Herald wrote that
Rahmat. Maybe I fly to Nurzhan one day instead of the bus 😂
Kids are back from nap, they want snow. Going to the park at 16:00, anyone?
Coming! Bring the mittens, the wet ones are still on the radiator
Snow on the Old City road now. Traffic slow near Liberty Boulevard
Snow here too. Sheep in the yard don't like it. Mine are stubborn
Horse shed is warm enough. Tyres covered, chains on the trailer just in case
Ok somebody please tell me what the Chu ulak result was. Jarysh says not received yet
Chu's match is next Saturday, Nurbek. Ulak is on Jarysh, they'll post it
Ah, I thought they played today. Ok
Kyzyl-Adyr hot springs this weekend? Marshrutka 30 som, Aizada asked. Still on?
Maybe next week, it's too cold for the springs now. Temperature there is 3 high, -8 low
So we hot spring next week 😂
Air in Nurzhan is 271 today, very unhealthy. Bars wants a new collar but I can't go out there 😷
Our kids stay inside in Nurzhan at Gulzada's sister's. Our air is 155 here, not too bad
Nurzhan fog, inversion sitting on the city. Mask on the hook still
Walnuts from the Toktogul side? I hear the reservoir is down. Hope it's fine for the power
Power is normal in Talas, no cuts planned. Reservoir is 80% full, not a problem this winter
Tulparcoin is up 5.3% on the day, 3.49 US cents. Still not money 😂
Tulparcoin is not money, Timur, I told you on Thursday 🙄
I know Begaiym, I'm just saying it went up 😂
Repair counter closed Saturday at 6, good. I'm tired. Anyone watching the football tomorrow?
Tulpar is at home? No, Neftchi was 2-1 and we're second. Attelkom are at home in the Cup final on the 7th, 2-0 to Neftchi
Ah, the Cup already. Neftchi won 2-0 there, right?
Yes, 2-0 Attelkom. Season is Neftchi's, 63 points. We're 62. One point gap, nothing left to play
Dastgoh 3rd on 42, Attelkom 4th on 38. Good for the kids to know the table 😅
Ulak round 12 on Saturday: Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00, Akjele v Karakoyun at 14:00. Not my sport but I'll check Jarysh
Marat you're turning into a ulak fan 😂 Rahmat for the times
Night shift for the Kara-Buura fans? Their next football match is the final round, nothing to play for
Kara-Buura 9th on 25 points, nothing to play for. Sorry Nurbek 😅
Ok the Saturday walk is cancelled for tomorrow then, too much snow. Sunday instead?
Sunday is good, kids will be happy 🐶
Potatoes 2.10 still. Rahmat all for the bazar talk, goodnight soon
Booth opens Monday 9. Don't ask me the rate before coffee
[sticker: haha]
Bar's new collar? Rustam you should sell Bars a phone 😂
He has a phone, he needs a collar with a tag. Owner's number on it, honest
Night. Saw a brown dog by the Attelkom building again, not Bars, a bigger one 😂
Night all. Bars is home, checked 🐶
Night. Bus back to the depot at 6:10. Hot tea please for the drivers 🫖
Night all. Hay ordered for next week, 26 som a bale, same as today
Night everyone. Warm hats on, the snow is still falling 🧣❄️
Night. Talasbank queue Monday, 8am. Pray for me
Night. Sunday rest, nobody argue about the coin 🙏
Night. Potatoes 2.10 tomorrow, Bakyt's favourite number
Night all 🐶
Night. Rahmat all

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Батарея шумит как самолёт 😅
Это воздух в системе. Завтра стравить, Костя, не ночью
Доброе утро, Нуржан. Воздух 164 по американской шкале, окна не открываем 😩
Доброе утро! Дети кашляют, я уже всех в маски. Смог сегодня густой
На смене видно через трубы, уже не то что вчера. Нефтянка дымит, а кто-то про котельные молчит
Нефтянка, ну и накидываешь 😄 Мы в Политехе измеряем, PM2,5 74 с хвостом. Это почти вся мелочь с котельных
Ладно, спорить не будем. Я в лабу пошла, коины ждут
Good morning! Is the air always like this in winter? 😷
Аигерим, в декабре и январе бывает хуже. Бери маску для дороги, не стесняйся
Rahmat 🙏 I bought one yesterday at the bazar
Дастгох опять без воды до обеда? Громкоговоритель молчит
Нет, сегодня вода есть. Вчера было, сегодня нормально
Бензин опять 5,40 на АИ-92 у Нефтянки? Заправлюсь на обратном
5,40 да. Дизель 6,10. Налоги на топливо растут, а на колонке как было
Herald писал: налог на продажу топлива +9%, 468 млн за десять месяцев. Цены на колонке не тронули, вот и вся история
Ага, налог растёт, а мне в карман не капает 😂
Коллеги, в аптеке на Навбахоре опять нет нормального аспирина для детей. Кто видел?
В аптеке на Дастгохе был, вроде есть. Звони сначала
Спасибо 🙏 Схожу после работы
Ребят, в Таласе на Вокзале сегодня опять очередь в Талас банке, я уже час стою
Мы же вчера говорили. Курс у меров на Базаре: доллар 11,50 покупка, 12 продажа. Официальный 8,40
Выгоднее менять на рынке, чем через банк с комиссией 1,2–2,5%. Но аккуратно с фальшивками
Не советую менять у незнакомых 😬 Официально — только банк, и это не 12
Игорь прав. Я вчера слышала про двух человек в Иык-Жаныле, у них на бумажках разница
In Talas I changed at the bank, long queue but no tricks 🙂
Тулпар 62, мы 63. Один очко, и два тура? Нет, туров ноль, чемпионат закончен. Нефтянка чемпион
Чемпион! Поздравляем 🏆 Кубок и чемпионат в одном году, редко
Андрей, ты сам поздравь себя 😄 Наши молодцы
Кто-нибудь смотрел про Чу и Высокогорную? В 19:00 полуфинал не выше 2 очков, но 12-го
Дилноза, 12-го не сейчас. Сегодня 26-е. Полуфинал Чу с местом 2 Высокогорной в субботу 12-го, в 19:00
Ну да, не путай 😄 Я про Талас и первое место, в 21:00
Я пойду на 21:00 с друзьями, Талас против первого места Высокогорной. Кто с нами?
Я в Талас не поеду, маршрутка 38 после семи только частники за 60

Kara-Buura pitch in the wind today? I heard the pass side is closed, so the bus will come from the valley road
Kara-Buura is at home, they play Neftchi? no that was last week, it's Kyzyl-Adyr for the football? confused now 😅
Kara-Buura play football, Kyzyl-Adyr is the Neftchi away trip. Saturday. Read the fixtures bro 😂
Ребята, кто в Кызыл-Адыр? Мне нужны два места в автобусе от клуба 🖤🧡
Vika the club bus is just the Talas marshrutka with a sticker on it 😂 30 som to Kyzyl-Adyr
Semiz plays Iyık Janyl at home next week, the snow is coming, we'll see who turns up
Coal is 22 a bag? Bakyt you paid that for real?
Yes Timur, and the wood is 8 bags for the winter. Potatoes are cheaper than heating 😂
Bakyt, the heating bill in my block is also 1 per cent of my wage 🐆 this winter is cruel
Shift B is cold. Fog and inversion in Nurzhan, PM2.5 at 196 and climbing. Nobody sits outside tonight 😷
Take the mask for the shift Andrei. My cousin's kid already has a cough from the air 😷
[sticker: kalpak]
Tonight the Irad Cup final highlights on the Iradi site, 2–0, Neftchi again. Someone is going to say it's rigged 😂
Not rigged, just better. Vika, enjoy the cup, the league gap is 1 point and we're still in it 🤍❤️
1 очко, и мы чемпионы. Спокойной ночи Талас 🖤🧡
Kara-Buura finished 9th on 25. Solid. Next season we want 8th 😄
Deportivo Semiz 3rd in the First League, don't forget it 😤
[sticker: haha]
Still no word on the 16 November court date. Bakyt, you know anything?
Adjourned to 16 November, no injunction. Not my business, I just grow potatoes 😅
Jolbors season ticket 2027 still club office only, bring ID. Not on the app 🐆
Ermek the app is a joke for tickets anyway. Went to the office, took 40 min
Saturday NurGaz derby was 2–1, 63 pts, we're champions. The cold makes it all feel bigger 🖤🧡
Champions in the cold, nobody argues. Talas 2nd on 62 is still the best season in years 🤍❤️
Thank you Nazgul. Admit it Andrei, you were nervous in the last round
A little 😅
[sticker: horse_love]
Chu in the play-offs? Dastgoh and Chu, I don't know who to back in the ISEZ Conference, Talas is 2nd 🤷
Talas 25 pts in the ISEZ. Play-off semi on 12 Dec at the Hippodrome, Talas v Highland place 1 at 21:00. Save the date 🤍❤️
Ulak play-offs at the Hippodrome, but Semiz is 11th so I'm watching the football 😂
Going to the Hippodrome in the snow is a crazy plan. I'm bringing thermos and a blanket 🧣
Scarves both sides again 🧣
Night all. Coal, potatoes, cold. Tomorrow the bags go out 🥔🔥
Night. Mask on. Derby decided, champions 🖤🧡
Night. Ours in the Cup next year 😂🤍
Спокойной ночи 🖤🧡

diaspora.t: Morning from London, dark and wet 🌧️ who's up
Up, coffee in hand. Surgut and Novosib asleep probably 😂
Surgut is awake, I'm in the car warming it up. -20 again
Novosib says hi too 🥶 radiators still cold
Almaty 2 degrees and sunny. Jealous of nobody 😂
Sunny in Almaty is a crime when we have this 😭
Lunch break: Berlin Iradi group found a place that does real plov on Saturdays. 28 euro for a plate? No, I'm joking, it's cheaper
Ask them about beet suzma pls 🙏
They say the beet is the problem, not the recipe 😄
Mom sent me a photo of the walnuts from Toktogul bazar. 22 som a kilo and she's still complaining it's too high
Walnuts at 22 and she complains? Tell her the Moscow ones are at 1,500 rubles 😂
She says Moscow walnuts have no taste anyway
Air in Nurzhan is 164 today, unhealthy. My sister says the kids stay in
Talas 150 for sensitive groups, Iyık Janyl 177. Everyone's lungs are on holiday 😷
Mum says she's wearing the mask on the marshrutka now. Even in the flat
[sticker: kalpak]
Kalpak on the Moscow metro, people look at me 😂
Tulparcoin 3.45 cents at noon, down 2.2%. Still not my problem 😂
Keep saying that, it's working for you
Did anyone watch the Women's League last round? Universitet beat Iyık Janyl 3–2
Tulpar Talas drew 2–2 with Akademiya, so the top is still Tulpar 23 and Universitet 22
Attelkom 3–0 over Neftchi women's team, nobody saw that coming 😅
Berlin question: the Almaty bus to Talas, does it stop at Kara-Balta or go straight?
Straight through, one stop for toilets and tea. Bring snacks and a blanket 😅
Ask about the Kyrgyz passport thing, Kostya. Did you ever get the copy answer?
Consulate says original ISEZ ID and birth certificate. So same as Nurlan said 🙃
Mum says the Chatkal diesel is 8.55–9.75 in the villages. Why is it so far from the bazar price?
Because there's no pump and the lorry does the driving 😂
Diesel at 6.10 in Talas. Mum says don't go to Chatkal without a full tank
Who's coming to the ISEZ round 11 results? Talas 10–6 Kyzyl-Adyr is old news, Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz now 😄
Nurzhan is 22 now and Chu is still 26. Round 12 is Saturday 🙂
[sticker: tlpr_down]
Who's flying to Talas for the play-off on 12 Dec? Hippodrome, 19:00 Chu v Highland place 2
Not me, I'm going for the final on the 19th 😂
Night for me soon. Üygö kaytkım kelet 🥲
Night Seoul. Yogurt tomorrow 🥣
Book the Almaty bus, Dinara 🚌
Can't sleep, London cold and the radiator is making noises 😩
Morning from Chicago. Mom sent a photo of the Talas hills, first snow on the top 😍
Novosib -18 this morning. Winter is official now, I saw the snow on the shore already
Ansan 3 degrees, rain. Bek is dreaming about Talas snow 🥲
Surgut -22 and the car needs 10 minutes to start. Nurzhan people are complaining about the fog and the coal smoke, lol. Winter has arrived everywhere
Mum says Nurzhan is 212 today, very unhealthy. She's telling everyone to stay in 😷
Almaty is clear and cold. Hard to believe Nurzhan is in the fog like that
Winter has come to Irad, ISEZ round 12 is Saturday, who's watching the Highland games? 🏇
Bought yogurt for the beet suzma experiment. Turkish shop, strained, Seoul you owe me a photo 😄
Will do! Mum says dill from Ansan market is not the same but I'll try 🌿
Tulparcoin 3.32 at noon, down 3.7% today. Dinara, the Moscow kids are going to be sad 😂
Not my problem again 😂 I'm buying a kümöch jar instead of crypto
Changers in Bazar-i Kalan at 11.50 buy for dollars this morning. My mum in Talas says it's better than last month
Official rate still 8.40. Nobody ever believes the official one 😅
Dollars through Almaty again. Mom says walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 som a kilo, she wants to make 3 jars of nut paste for the winter
Anyone else's parents asking about the winter fuel? Mum says diesel in Talas is 6.10 and the coal is up again
Mum says the heating is on in Talas but the flat is still cold. Lol the radiators are for decoration
[sticker: kalpak]
Surgut radiators work too well. Open window in December 😂
Bus Talas to Nurzhan is 32 som. Marshrutka 38 som. Mum says the marshrutka is faster but the bus has heating
Bus has heating? Mine is cold every time 🥶
Ainagul you need the marshrutka with the old driver, he keeps the stove going 😄
Irad League last round said Neftchi Nurzhan are champions. Congrats to Nurzhan fans here 🖤🧡
Neftchi won the title on the last day, 63 points. Tulpar 62 😭 one point!!
My cousin in Talas is still crying over that 2–1 loss 😂
Tulpar fans will say the referee... but ok, a champion is a champion 🙂
Question: how is the Sary-Bulak spur going? Mum read the 21.4m som tender closed
Spur is due back spring 2027 they said. My uncle in Lower Naryn says the 71 new firms in nine months is great news
71 firms and 520 jobs in Lower Naryn? That is more than my whole street 😂
Berlin question: who's flying to Talas for the play-off on 12 Dec? Hippodrome 19:00 Chu v Highland place 2
Me for the final on 19 Dec, 19:00 at the State Hippodrome 🐎
[sticker: horse_love]
Mom says Talas air terminal has room for more flights, but summer 2027 routes are still open. Dreaming of a Chicago flight 😅
Night here soon. Üygö kaytkım kelet 🥲
Night Seoul. Yogurt tomorrow, I promise 🥣
Round 12 Saturday, Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00. Anyone up for a late bet? 😂
Late night here and I still can't sleep. Turkish yogurt is in the fridge, beet is not 😅
Good morning from Moscow ☕ Snow here already, my kümöch jar is on the table
Mum in Talas says the frost is -9 at night and the flat is still cold. Same story every year 😩
Surgut -20 and the radiators are on full. Trade you 😂
Berlin is grey and wet, not even snow. I miss proper winter lol
Be careful what you wish for Ainagul 🥶
Mom checked the Nurzhan air this morning. It's very unhealthy there, she says the whole valley smells of coal smoke
Ugh. Mum says she keeps the windows shut and the kids inside. Nurzhan people have my sympathy 😷
Talas is better today, 155 on the index. Still unhealthy. Mum says wear a mask on the bazar
Bazar-i Kalan changers at 11.45 buy for dollars this morning. Mum says it's not bad for a Saturday
Better than last week 👍 I'll send some before the new year
Euros are 12.50 buy at the same changer. If your mum needs euros, the spread is worse 😬
Who's watching Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00? Moiynkum is in the Highland Conference, not the ISEZ one right?
Yes Highland. Round 12 today, Boztorgoy are top on 30 pts. Moiynkum are bottom 🙃
Bottom with 3 points, so Boztorgoy should win easy. Don't tell the Moiynkum fans I said that
Cousin in Talas says the walnuts at Toktogul bazar are still 22 som a kilo. Making the nut paste this weekend, 3 jars
Question: anyone know the Talas to Iyık Janyl bus? Mum wants to visit her sister
45 som from Talas. Take the bus, it's warmer than the marshrutka in winter
Thanks aizhan 🙏
Does anyone here know if the Gulf hospital at Tash-Kömür will really get 150 beds? Sounds too good 😂
22m dollars is the figure in the paper. We'll see. Talas people have heard promises before 🙄
Tulparcoin is up 5.3% today, 3.49 cents. Anyone trading? I bought a little for my mum's birthday 😅
Not legal tender Kostya! Tell your mum to keep the dollars 😂
Rain in Almaty, dark already. Anyone else's parents asking about firewood? Mum says the coal is up again
Surgut says the same about the coal. Dad bought a whole winter load early this year
Anyone watched the ulak tartysh from Kara-Bulak yet? My brother sent me a clip of the sheep 😅
The Kara-Bulak lads are in the ISEZ conference, Dastgoh beat them 5–2 last week. Ask him about that one lol
Dinara you and your Dastgoh. Let it go 😂
Playoffs: Chu v Highland place 2 on 12 Dec at the Hippodrome, 19:00. Who's going? Ainagul?
Yes, I booked a Talas flight via Istanbul. Dinara, see you on 19 Dec too? 🐎
Yes! The final, 19:00 State Hippodrome 🐎🖤🧡
Round 12 done for the Highland fans. Anyone up for a late bet on the ISEZ table? 😂
No betting, I just want to know if Talas will be top of ISEZ by the playoffs 😅
Üygö kaytkım kelet 🥲 night everyone

tulparcoin.t: Coin at the morning 3.5c? Ulan you still awake or did you sell in your sleep 😂
Still holding. The coin doesn't sleep so I don't either
Morning all. Talas is clear but cold, my car has ice like a cake 🧊
TLPR 3.45c at noon-ish is what the offshore board says. -2.2% today. Not financial advice, just reading numbers 😅
Reading numbers is allowed. Acting on them at 8am is how you end up at the bazar with a coin in your pocket
In my day we had one kind of money and it was bread 😄
Night shift done. Nurzhan is 164 on the air board, unhealthy. The coin is the least of my worries this morning
Mask on the bus, Andrei. Not a lecture, a reminder 😷
Yes yes 🙄
Мама опять спрашивает про TLPR. Сказала, что соседка уже продала 😩
Tell her the old woman from Talas says the dollar at the bazar is 11.50 to buy and 12 to sell, and that's a real price 😄
Спасибо, апа. Она скажет что это нечестно 😂
Lunch. Potatoes 2.10 a kilo at the bazar, I'm glad I grow mine. Apples in Chu 3.45 and nobody wants them 🍎
Apples 3.45 and the coin 3.45 😂 Same number, one of them I can eat
Lol Elvira. I'd rather eat the apple, but the coin is the one that might give me a free lunch someday
Rinat that sticker is an insult to my portfolio 😤
Thursday 18:30 at Tündük, still on. Who's coming besides Elvira and her bus English?
Me. I practised the word 'inversion' on the bus. Still don't know what it means 😂
Temperature inversion, the cold air sits under the warm, the smoke can't go up. Good word for a Nurzhan winter
Iyık Janyl 177 today. Their air is worse than ours and I still don't see anyone rushing to buy a mask 🙃
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar 22 a kilo. My sister says they're cheaper on the road but I don't trust the road in November
Toktogul fog today, high 5, low -4. Walnuts will keep, the fog won't 😂
Shift B starts. Refinery road clear, pass is chains only. Air board says 164, I'll take the mask on the bike again
Andrei, wear it. You promised 😂
I promised nothing 🙃
Toktogul reservoir 80.9% and going down fast. Power normal in Talas, no cuts. Lights on again 💡
Stop reading the reservoir like a coin chart 😂
Coin at six 3.45c. Holding. Just a bit more, then I'll sell my dignity and buy bread
Tulpar still second on the table, one point off Neftchi. I'm not talking about it. I'm talking about the Irad Cup on Saturday 😤
Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom in the Cup final, Saturday. Timur stop it 😂
That's a Saturday prediction, not a result. Let me have my sadness in peace
Coffee at Tündük after the English? Plov and the walnuts, apa says the bread's on her
Bring your English, I bring the rice 🍚
Coin at eight 3.4c. -2 on the day. Someone tell me something good before bed
Nurzhan air 164 and my nephew's cat is sleeping on the radiator. Good news 🐈
Good news: Fergana Gateway open with chains. Bad news: I'm still not going anywhere 🙏
Coin at ten 3.45c. Still holding. Going to bed before it wakes up 😂
Jakshı tünö all. Air 162 in Nurzhan, window closed 🌙
Jakshı tünö all. Window closed 🌙
Still holding. Coin asleep, me asleep 😴
Morning. Talas clear, minus 7 on the car thermometer 🥶
Coin at open 3.3c. Down a bit again. Nobody panic before coffee
Panic is for after the first queue at Talasbank ☕
Winter has come officially. Snow on the Chu fields this morning, first time this year
Good. Snow means the walnuts keep. Put the coal in the stove, children
Nurzhan fog again, 212 on the air board. I can't see the chimney from the bike 🙃
Andrei, mask. Please. For Elvira's sake 😂
[sticker: kalpak]
Inversion day. Cold air sitting on the city like a lid 🫖
Our nephew says the heating bill came and the cat is now the most expensive member of the family
Bazar changers this morning: USD 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell. Bank says 8.40. Who is making the money here 🤷
The changers, the bank and the pigeons at the Kalan. Everyone eats
Diesel 6.10 at the Kyzyl-Adyr pump. Chatkal villages pay 8.55 and up. The mountains always pay more
Chatkal diesel is in a report somewhere that nobody reads. Typical
Всем доброе утро! Кто-нибудь знает, работает ли сегодня Attelkom обменник?
Не работает, Светлана. Баланс в приложении есть, а обмена нет. Ждём
Ждём, дочка. Чай пьём пока 🍵
Coin at nine 3.3c. Flat-ish. Someone tell me the Gulf fund's hospital is a good thing and I'll feel better
A 150-bed hospital at Tash-Kömür is a good thing. 22m dollars sounds like someone is serious
Serious until the paperwork goes to the regional office, then we see 🙃
Thursday English at Tündük was great, Elvira your inversion now has a face 😂
I used it on Andrei. He said 'I promised nothing'
That's correct, I promised nothing 🙃
Lunch break. Plov at the corner, 28 som a plate, my wallet is crying
Plov at 28 with no meat is a crime. In my canteen it was 9 and we still had meat 😂
Apples in Chu 3.45 a kilo this week. Good year for the orchards, bad year for the buyers
So buy apples, sell coins, eat plov. Simple life
Irad Cup was Saturday 2-0 Neftchi. I'm over it. Mostly 😤
You said that about the Cup before the Cup 😂
Coin at one 3.2c. Going down with the snow. Nice match of weather
[sticker: bee]
Walnuts at Toktogul still 22. Ask me again next week
Anyone checked the Fergana Gateway? I have to go to Nurzhan tomorrow by bus
Open, chains or winter tyres required. The Kara-Buura pass is shut for winter, so not that way 🙏
Good. Bus Talas to Nurzhan 32, I'm sitting in the back out of respect for my lungs
Shift B. Air board 212 now. Mask on, bike to the refinery, like a good husband of the air
Good man 😂
Tulpar still second. One point off Neftchi. Season's over, I'm allowed to be sad now
Season's over, the table isn't. 63 and 62, Timur, that's still a table 😂
Talas air clean-ish, 157. My window is open for exactly three minutes a day, like a ritual
Coin at six 3.3c. Still holding my 100. The dignity is almost sold 😂
[sticker: kosh]
Thursday English again? Tündük, 18:30. Bring a word that means 'cold' and one that means 'coin'
Cold: суық. Coin: tiyin. I checked on my phone like a student 😂
Toktogul reservoir down again today. Lower water, higher talk. Rain would be nice 🌧️
Stop reading the reservoir like a coin chart, Toktosun 😂
Who wants a last cup of tea? Samovar still warm at my flat
Yes apa, bring the biscuits. Thanks for the plov on Thursday too 🙏
Nurzhan air 201 now. The cat has moved from the radiator to my pillow. Still good news 🐈
Coin at nine 3.3c. Holding my small share, not my dignity. Jakshı tünö
Frost forecast for Chu tonight, minus 4 at the farm. Sleep well, everyone 🌙
Coin at eleven 3.3c. Going to bed before the bazar wakes up 😴
Jakshı tünö all. Window closed 🌙
Still awake. The cat is on the keyboard. Coin at 3.3c last I looked, nothing moves at night 🐈
Up before the cows. Frost on the windows, minus 4 at the farm. Coin 3.5c on the offshore board this morning?
Offshore says 3.49 at noon yesterday no wait, today. Up 5.3% on the day. I am still holding my 100 🤷
Nobody can tell me what 'offshore' means. Is it near the sea? We have no sea 😂
It means somewhere else, Elvira. Like your pension 😂
Bazar changers this morning 11.45 buy, 12 sell for dollars. Plov at the canteen still 28, I checked on my way to the bakery
Shift B starts at 8 and Nurzhan is 271 on the air board. I can't see the chimney from the gate 😷
Mask on Andrei. Tulpar says it is not money, the air says it is definitely something 😄
Talas 155 at the moment, mine is 3 minutes of window again. Who else is going to Nurzhan this weekend?
Мама опять смотрит курс. Говорит «ещё чуть-чуть». Что делать?
Give her a cup of tea and take the phone away 😄 Same as with the rats in my flat
Серьёзно, Гульмира апа, лучше чай. Свету, пусть подождёт до весны
Tulpar Talas at Universitet this Saturday? No, wait, the table is done. Still, I'll go to the Hippodrome for the play-offs in December 🙂
Play-offs are on the Hippodrome 12 Dec, Chu against the Highland second place at 19:00. We will be there with the thermos
Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00, then Highland place 1 v Talas at 21:00. Two games in one evening, bring a blanket 🧣
Diesel 6.10 at my station, petrol 95 at 5.85. The van eats more than the coin does 🚚
Anyone going to Kyzyl-Adyr this week? I need hay for my cousin's horses, bale is 26 in the valleys
Hay at 26 a bale is a good price for us. Winter comes and nobody sells hay for love 😂
Lower Naryn registered 71 new firms in nine months, 31 in Bazar-Korgon. Someone there must be selling chairs 😄
Ask the chairs what they think of Tulpar Pay, I bet they want TLPR too
Thursday English is on. Bring one word for 'frost' and one for 'queue' 🙏
Queue is 'ocheret'. Frost is 'aiaz'. I learned them at the bazar, not in school 😄
Lunch time. Plov for two 28 each, I refuse to pay for a third 😤
Off shift in an hour. Coin 3.4c offshore at noon? Someone tell me it's over the bottom before I sleep
Noon board says 3.49c, +5.3%. I've been awake since 6 and I'm still holding 100 🤷
Holding is a feeling, not a plan. Also not financial advice, as always 😄
Walnuts at Toktogul still 22. Ask me again next week, I am not a bazar report
Teller shift done. Talasbank counter had a man ask whether TLPR can be deposited. Told him to ask the Bank of Irad, I only count real som 😂
Toktogul reservoir 80.3% full, drawing down. Water is going out to the power exports on schedule. The lake is quieter than this chat
Lower water, higher talk, Toktosun said that yesterday. Keep the quotes coming 😄
Tündük tonight or Thursday? I thought Thursday. Someone check the calendar pls
Thursday, Elvira. Tonight is just a Saturday with tea. Come if you want 🍵
Home. Nurzhan air 212 now, the flat has a clean corner by the stove. The cat says that's enough ❤️
Samovar is on. Who is coming for the last cup? Biscuits are from the canteen, I took three
Coming apa. Tulpar still second, one point off, and the biscuits are the only real currency tonight 😂
Coin at 3.5c at ten. Still holding my small share. Jakshı tünö all 🌙

chaikhana.t: Kayırluu tañ! Bread is warm, I baked the nan at 5, come get it before the kids eat it all
Gulmira apa 😩 I'm at the booth at 9, can't come. Save me one end piece
Доброе утро. Тумана в Токтогуле нет? Муж собирается ехать через перевал
Toktogul is fog, the bus driver says the road is ok, slow down at the bends
Jakshı tañ! Today's English word: 'frost'. Use it in a sentence before lunch 😄
Frost is what my hands are today. Cold stable mornings 🥶
Ice on the Talas windows again. My kids want to make a snowman, I said wait for snow first
Coming from Nurzhan this month, the air is different here. Talas is -4 at night and I still like it
Cold is good for the nan, it keeps longer. Drink your tea, all of you ☕
Changers this morning: dollar 11.50 buy, 12 sell. Euro 12.50 / 13.10. Hands are frozen, the till is slow
Begaiym, the euro for the Almaty trip? Ask your mum, she is paying 😂
Not for Almaty, for the Iradi women's team bus 😂 Aidana, you go and see the exchange rate yourself
Аптека открыта. Пришли три человека с кашлем, у всех одно и то же. Пейте тёплое
Honey and lemon, Svetlana. And the kids need hats 🧣
Tyres: winter tyres still in the shop, people come in asking for chains. Fergana road needs them, the sign says so
Chains or winter tyres on the Fergana Gateway, Marat? Good to know for my students driving to Ala-Bel
Yes Aizada, chains or winter tyres. The pass is closed in winter anyway, so don't go over Kara-Buura
Lunch: plov from yesterday, reheated with a little water. Not as good, but not bad 😅
Plov at a counter is sad. Phone repair goes on with a cold hand, the screen is soldered by a numb finger
Rustam, a plate of plov is 28 som at the canteen by the bus stop. Cheaper than a screen
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo. Gulmira apa's bread needs a whole bag 😂
Exactly. I'll make the walnut bread for Sunday's table, Marat brings the bag from the car 🥜
Коллеги спрашивают, как долго будет держаться холод. Я сказала: до весны, мы же в Нуржане хоть не пятнадцать градусов
Nurzhan has the smog, the sky is grey all day. My eldest coughs when he goes out to school 😩
Air in Nurzhan is 164 today, unhealthy, and Iyık Janyl is 177. Talas is 150 for sensitive people. Mask on for the children
Маски и много воды. Дети пусть не бегают на улице после обеда
My horse does not like the smoke either. The Hippodrome stables smell of coal, not hay
Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale. My two horses eat through it like it's nothing. Long winter ahead
Anyone watching the ulak? Akjele v Karakoyun Saturday at Upper Besh-Tash, Akjele is in the top half
Rustam, you said that yesterday 😂 I'm sure you'll bring the flask again
Ulak Saturday 14:00 for the flask, Rustam. Bring two
Ulak scores I don't follow, but I know who on the bench cheers the loudest 😂
Reminder: Thursday English/Iradi exchange at Tündük café at 18:30 tonight. Bring a word, take a word 🙂
Аизада, я приду. Могу научить английскому слову 'аптека' 😂
Kids are home, the radiator is warm in the kindergarten room but the corridor is still freezing. Heating on since autumn
My counter door is open all day too. Same as Begaiym, the booth is cold
Tulparcoin is 3.45 cents this noon, down 2.2 on the day. Still not money, my uncle says. Still a joke 😂
Still not legal tender, Marat. Please don't pay the walnut man in Tulparcoin 😂
Evening tea soon. Aidana, is your mother still watching the Nurzhan doctors on IradOne tonight?
She is, Saturday is the new episode but she watches the repeats too 😂
Ушла в Тундук. Аизада, до встречи
Home. Changers closed at 7. Dollar 12 sell at the morning, I wanted to tell someone 😂
Fuel: petrol AI-92 at 5.40 at the pump, diesel 6.10. My tyre shop still runs the truck on it
Diesel in Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75. Sadly I don't drive there, my cousin does. He says it's a lot
Fuel tax up 9% to 468m som in Jan–Oct, the Herald says pump prices are unchanged. Good, but the bus fares went up in my head 😅
Taxi from 15 som in Talas and the marshrutka Talas–Nurzhan is 38. Gulzada, your head is right, the bus is 32
Grain harvest closed at 486,300 tonnes. Stores full, but the diesel is not cheap, my husband says
The stores are full, the hay is not. Ask the Chu farmers about the hay price, they don't laugh
Wedding season: I ride kyz kuu at the Talas toi on Saturday. Everyone wants the old Ak Börü, Rustam will be sad
